titles.zh-Hant: 請問您今天要來點兔子嗎？
titles.ja: ご注文はうさぎですか?
titles.zh-Hans: 请问您今天要来点兔子吗?

title.ja: ひと目で, 尋常でないもふもふだと見抜いたよ
title.en: I Knew at First Glance That It Was No Ordinary Fluffball
title.fr: Au premier regard, j’ai deviné qu’il était incroyablement moelleux
title.x-jat: Hitome de, Jinjou de Nai Mofumofu Da to Minuita yo

1.overview: Cocoa's first day at the Rabbit House Cafe is lively as she meets and becomes friends with Chino and Lize in a heartbeat.
1.summary:
Cocoa has moved into the new town where she`ll start attending high school in spring. She gets lost and enters a café called Rabbit House to ask for directions...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 小麦を愛した少女と小豆に愛された少女
title.en: The Girl Who Loved Wheat and the Girl Loved by Azuki Beans
title.fr: La fille qui aimait la farine et une fille aimée par les haricots sucrés
title.x-jat: Komugi o Aishita Shoujo to Azuki ni Aisareta Shoujo

2.overview: While getting ready for the first day of school, Cocoa runs into a new friend at the park. Cocoa's and her friends decide to bake bread and visit Chiya's coffee house.
2.summary:
On the way to her new school, Cocoa meets a girl in traditional Japanese clothes named Chiya. It turns out Chiya will be attending the same high school as Cocoa, and her hobby is giving original names to the Japanese sweets she makes.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 初めて酔った日の事憶えてる? 自分の家でキャンプファイヤーしようとしたわよね
title.en: Do You Remember the Day You First Got Drunk? You Tried to Light a Campfire in Your Own Home, Didn`t You?
title.fr: Te souviens-tu de la dernière fois où tu étais soûl ? Tu essayais d’allumer un feu de camp chez toi
title.x-jat: Hajimete Yotta Hi no Koto Oboeteru? Jibun no Ie de Campfire Shiyou to Shita wa yo ne

3.overview: Cocoa and company make a new friend, Sharo. Afterward, they enjoy some tea at Sharo's teahouse and spend the night at Rabbit house telling scary stories.
3.summary:
Cocoa and friends are shopping for mugs when they meet Sharo, an underclassman at Lize`s school who`s also a childhood friend of Chiya`s. Later, Chiya is worried that Sharo is working in some shady establishment, so she and the other girls decide to infiltrate Sharo`s workplace.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ラッキーアイテムは野菜と罪と罰
title.en: Your Lucky Items Are Vegetables, Crime, and Punishment
title.fr: Les porte-bonheur sont les légumes, le crime et la punition
title.x-jat: Lucky Item wa Yasai to Tsumi to Batsu

4.overview: Cocoa practices her fortune telling technique using caffe-de-mancy, and the girls head to the library on a sunny afternoon.
4.summary:
When Cocoa sees Chino using caffè-de-mancy to tell fortunes with coffee, she has Chino teach her how to do it, then tries telling fortunes for Chino, Lize, and Tippy. After that, for some reason, all sorts of bad luck befalls Cocoa...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ココアと悪意なき殺意
title.en: Cocoa and Murderous Intent Without Malice

5.overview: The girls begin practicing for the ball sports tournament at school, with unsurprising results. Father's Day is near, and Rize takes up extra jobs to get her father a gift.
5.summary:
Cocoa says she needs to practice with Chiya for their school`s ball sports tournament, but for some reason, she doesn`t look happy as she leaves work early. Later, Chino and Lize head to the park to practice badminton, and they`re greeted by the sight of Cocoa and Chiya lying on the ground.
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: A Story About Telling a Story

6.overview: Chino's friends help out at the Rabbit House and take a shining to Cocoa and Lize, leaving Chino the odd man out.
6.summary:
Cocoa comes home to find Chino`s classmates, Maya and Megu, wearing uniforms and helping out at Rabbit House. Maya and Megu immediately become friends with Cocoa and Lize, but for some reason, watching them makes Chino feel bad.
Source: crunchyroll

7.overview: Chino and Cocoa get into small, cute fights with each other over puzzles and pancakes. Later, the girls hand out flyers for their cafes.
7.summary:
Lize notices that Chino doesn`t seem like her usual self. She asks Cocoa, who admits that she finished a jigsaw puzzle that Chino had enjoyed working on for a long time. Cocoa is so shocked by her failure as a big sister that she runs out of the café...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: プールに濡れて 雨に濡れて涙に濡れて
title.en: Wet with Pool Water, Wet with Rain, Wet with Tears
title.fr: Mouillée par la piscine, la pluie et les larmes
title.x-jat: Pool ni Nurete Ame ni Nurete Namida ni Nurete

8.overview: Cocoa and the other girls take it upon themselves to teach Rize how to swim at the hot spring pool. Late, they watch a movie based on Aoyama's book together.
8.summary:
Cocoa and the other girls visit a hot spring pool, where they have underwater breathing contests and teach Rize how to swim. Meanwhile, Chino and Chiya begin a game of chess with something big on the line...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 青山スランプマウンテン

9.overview: Chino learns from a stray paper airplane that Aoyama is quitting her job as a novelist and takes up a part-time job at the Rabbit House.
9.summary:
As Chino is walking home, a paper airplane made from manuscript paper flies toward her head. It was thrown by Aoyama Blue Mountain, who says she has quit her job as a novelist, so Chino brings her to Rabbit House.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 対お姉ちゃん用決戦部隊, 通称チマメ隊
title.en: The Anti-Sister Battle Corps, Also Known as the Chimame Corps
title.fr: Guerre fratricide, nom de code capitaine ampoules
title.x-jat: Tai Onee-chan You Kessen Butai, Tsuushou Chimame-Tai

10.overview: While Cocoa helps Chiya study for the upcoming exams, Megu and Maya help our at Rabbit House. Later, a trip to the pool is in order.
10.summary:
While Cocoa is absent from Rabbit House for an overnight study session at Chiya`s house, Maya and Megu come to spend the night with Chino. Rize watches Chino, Maya, and Megu as they work in the café and gives them the collective nickname "Chimame."
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 少女は赤い外套を纏いウサギを駆りて聖夜の空を行く
title.en: The Girl Dons a Red Coat and Drives a Team of Rabbits Across the Christmas Eve Night Sky
title.fr: Vêtue d’un manteau rouge, elle chevauche un lapin dans le ciel de la sainte nuit
title.x-jat: Shoujo wa Akai Gaitou o Matoi Usagi o Karite Seiya no Sora o Iku

11.overview: To celebrate the Christmas season, the girls decide to throw a Christmas party. Let the planning commence!
11.summary:
While shopping at a Christmas market, Cocoa and the other girls plan a Christmas party. Then on Christmas Day, Maya, Megu, and Aoyama-san join the gang, and their lively Christmas party begins.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 君のためなら寝坊する
title.en: For You, I Can Sleep Late
title.fr: Pour toi, je ferai la grasse matinée

12.overview: Cocoa runs a fever, and the girls head out to get her some medicine. After she heals, Chino ends up with the mumps.
12.summary:
On the way to school, Chino notices something strange about Cocoa and learns that she has a high fever. Rize and Chiya come to visit, but her fever won`t go down. When night falls, Chino realizes they`re out of cold medicine and sets out alone to find some...
Source: crunchyroll
